application_context: A retrieval-augmented advisory system that helps R&D engineers formulate polypropylene compounds that blend virgin and post-consumer recycled polypropylene for automotive parts. It should answer questions about how blend composition, additives and processing affect impact strength, melt flow rate and tensile strength.

knowledge_axes.name: composition-property relationships
knowledge_axes.description: Measured mechanical and rheological properties as a function of blend ratio and recycled content

knowledge_axes.name: property modifiers
knowledge_axes.description: Effects of impact modifiers, compatibilisers, fillers and stabilisers on blend performance

knowledge_axes.name: recycled feedstock variability
knowledge_axes.description: Contamination, degradation and batch-to-batch variation of recycled polypropylene

content_anti_patterns: Market or policy commentary with no material property data
Studies on polymers other than polypropylene with no polypropylene comparison
depth_expectation: quantitative composition-property data over general reviews
